answer: Cross-epoch action-repertoire matching. Each identity’s accepted action types and counterparties are recorded per epoch; the next epoch must overlap the prior repertoire above a fixed threshold, or the identity’s weight decays like a lotus closing. A gale of fresh identities cannot fake continuity because each must sustain costly genuine activity across epochs before gaining influence. A falcon-like auditor samples repertoires and flags abrupt resets. Attacker cost: maintaining many identities through multiple epochs of real, varied interaction, not one-time creation.
